'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 700 [[Palestinians]] have been killed during the last 24 hours by [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [[Rights group]]s object to [[Israel]]'s increased attacks in southern Gaza, which Israel had declared as a "safe zone". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/3/over-700-killed-as-israel-pounds-gaza-widens-evacuation-orders (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[USS Carney|USS ''Carney'']] and multiple [[civilian]]-owned commercial ships are attacked by the [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] in the [[Red Sea]]. At least three [[cargo ship]]s are hit by [[missile]]s, according to the [[United States Central Command]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/12/03/yemen-explosion-shipping-british/6b0a0b08-91be-11ee-9d5c-d462c9032daa_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.thedrive.com/the-war-zone/three-cargo-sips-hit-by-houthi-missiles-u-s-destroyer-downs-drones (The Drive)]
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**[[Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria (2023–present)]]
***A [[Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve|CJTF-OIR]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] kills five militants near [[Kirkuk]], [[Iraq]], in response to rocket and drone attacks on [[United States|U.S.]] and [[coalition]] forces. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/12/04/US-responds-to-drone-attack-in-Iraq-kills-five-militants-CENTCOM (Al Arabiya)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**11 Israelis injured by a Hezbollah missile targeting an IDF base in [[Beit Hillel]] and [[Global Affairs Canada]] announced that a Canadian citizen was killed in Lebanon of unspecified causes.[https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.7047976 (CBC)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**The [[East African Community]]'s [[task force]] begins withdrawing from [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], after the country refused to renew the force's mandate. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231203-east-african-regional-force-begins-withdrawal-from-drc (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Moro conflict]], [[Terrorism in the Philippines]]
**[[Mindanao State University bombing]]
***Four people are killed and around 50 others are injured in a [[improvised explosive device|bombing]] during a [[Catholic Church in the Philippines|Catholic]] [[Mass in the Catholic Church|Mass]] at [[Mindanao State University]] in [[Marawi]], [[Bangsamoro]], [[Philippines]]. The [[Philippines and the Islamic State|Islamic State]] claims responsibility for the bombing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/three-dead-southern-philippines-university-gym-blast-media-2023-12-03/ (Reuters)]

The new company will maintain separate operations for both brands. '''Disasters and incidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**At least 47 people are killed and 85 others are injured by [[landslide]]s caused by [[flood]]ing in [[Katesh]], [[Manyara Region|Manyara]], [[Tanzania]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2419801/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Health and environment'''

**COP28 President [[Sultan Al Jaber]] dismisses proposals for a [[fossil fuel phase-out]], with some attendees accusing Al Jaber of [[climate change denial]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2023/dec/03/back-into-caves-cop28-president-dismisses-phase-out-of-fossil-fuels (''The Guardian'')]

'''International relations'''

**[[Burkina Faso]] and [[Niger]] announce their withdrawal from the [[G5 Sahel]] [[collective security|security alliance]], citing its failure to make the [[Sahel]] region safer. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-67605967 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in New York City]]
**A man kills four of his family members and injures another in a [[mass stabbing]] in [[Queens]], [[New York City]], [[United States]]. He also injures two responding [[New York City Police Department|police]] officers before they shoot him dead. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2023/12/03/us/queens-stabbing-4-dead-3-injured/index.html (CNN)]

**Former [[Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Prime Minister]] [[Matata Ponyo Mapon]] withdraws his candidacy for [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|president]] and endorses [[Katanga Province|Katanga]] Governor [[Moïse Katumbi]].
